title: Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy and Regional Adrenalectomy in the management of Stage II & III Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
official: Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy and Regional Adrenalectomy in the management of Stage II & III Adrenocortical Carcinoma
summary: Main objective: Evaluation of the impact of HIPEC on the incidence of local or peritoneal recurrences of ACC, assessed through clinical examinations, blood biochemical tests, and thoraco-abdominal CT scan (with and without contrast) performed every 4 months, according to standard clinical practice.
sponsor: Azienda Socio Sanitaria Territoriale Degli Spedali Civili Di Brescia
